summary: Completed requested API and UI review. Browser E2E passed for desktop/mobile loading, five metrics, nonblank 3D canvas, emergency navigation, incident validation/create/resolve, AIRA, simulation, scenarios, and mobile overflow. Public API checks initially passed health, then became unavailable during a long AIRA/hot-reload cycle and recovered after managed backend restart.

critical.issue: Core API requests and WebSocket handshake timed out after the AIRA request while backend hot reload was restarting; supervisor logs show a long gpt-5.4 LLM call followed by reload shutdown. Service recovered after supervisor restart.

action_items: Investigate backend/public gateway resilience during long AIRA LLM streams and hot reload; ensure requests do not leave the service unresponsive.
critical_code_review_comments: AIRA streaming relies on the external LLM path when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured; timeout/cancellation handling should be bounded so the API remains responsive.

success_rate.backend: API assertions not fully completed due transient gateway timeout; health recovered 100%

seed_data_creation: Created TEST Browser Junction via UI and TEST-prefixed API test incident; test incidents are in-memory demo state and one was resolved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser run passed all requested flows. Public API was healthy initially, then timed out during/after assistant LLM request and backend hot reload; supervisor backend restart restored health. Test URL fallback was fixed to read only REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL line from frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: The original API test fallback read the entire frontend/.env after the first '=', appending WDS_SOCKET_PORT and ENABLE_HEALTH_CHECK into the hostname. After correcting that test-only parsing, the public endpoint initially responded, but the later suite timed out while logs showed an in-flight gpt-5.4 completion and backend reload shutdown. Restarting the managed backend restored /api/health 200.
